Player.personality: player character; adapt to the original text
Player.speechStyle: natural Japanese dialogue; do not add honorifics unless indicated by context

_narrator.speechStyle: clear, natural Japanese narration; descriptive rather than conversational
_narrator.notes: This text has no in-world speaker. Preserve the game-master or narrator perspective.

_system.notes: Do not make this sound like a character speaking.

Arueshalae.race: ascending succubus; formerly a succubus demon
Arueshalae.alignment: normally chaotic neutral; capable of redemption and sincere moral growth
Arueshalae.personality: polite, shy, guarded, self-critical, sincere, observant, and quietly hopeful. She fears her former sadistic and manipulative nature and is careful not to return to it. Her attempts to understand mortal customs can be awkward, but are genuine.
Arueshalae.speechStyle: Use a feminine but restrained voice. She speaks politely and thoughtfully, with occasional hesitation when discussing intimacy, friendship, desire, guilt, or her past. Do not make her childish, excessively cute, or melodramatic. Preserve her occasional dry or gentle humor.

firstPerson.rule: Always use 私 as her Japanese first-person pronoun. Do not switch to あたし, 僕, or 俺.

addressingPlayer.rule: When the English text explicitly says Commander or uses a title-like direct address, translate it as 指揮官様. When it says you in ordinary direct speech, use あなた only when needed for natural Japanese; omit it when Japanese would normally omit the subject. Do not replace every you with 指揮官様.

Arueshalae.notes: She is a companion and a romance character. Respectful boundaries and her struggle toward redemption are important subtext. In a corrupted or fallen story state, her tone may become more confident, seductive, cruel, or cynical; do not apply that tone unless the surrounding dialogue indicates that state. Keep Desna, redemption, dreams, and mortal customs conceptually consistent.

Aivu.personality: playful, innocent, food-loving, cheerful, energetic, and intensely loyal. She views the world with childlike wonder and speaks directly without malice or deception. Loves cookies and candy.
Aivu.speechStyle: Childlike, energetic, and plain-spoken Japanese. Expresses enthusiasm freely. Uses short, direct sentences.

firstPerson.rule: Use アイヴー or わたし. Keeps a innocent, youthful tone. Do not use overly mature or adult phrasing.

addressingPlayer.rule: Addresses the player warmly and casually. Omit subjects when natural in Japanese.

Aivu.notes: She is the Havoc Dragon companion for the Azata Mythic Path. Maintain a childlike, cute, and joyful tone throughout.

Camellia.personality: aristocratic, refined, arrogant, condescending, secretive, and sadistically psychotic underneath her noble poise. She looks down on commoners and maintains an elegant exterior.
Camellia.speechStyle: High-class, polite, and refined upper-class Japanese (お嬢様言葉). Uses smooth, polite verbs while hiding dark, sadistic, or contemptuous undercurrents.

addressingPlayer.rule: Addresses the player with refined politeness. Uses 指揮官様 when acknowledging status, or あなた in direct speech.

Camellia.notes: Her helpfulness is useful, but her spirit-shaman alignment and secret rituals stem from a sadistic urge. Keep her speech elegant even when her comments are cold or sinister.

Ciar.personality: stern, rigid, duty-bound, honorable, and unyielding knightly order leader (Everbright Crusaders). As an undead grave guard, he becomes cold, hollow, and bound to dark magic.
Ciar.speechStyle: Formal, rigid, and military/knightly Japanese. Speaks with heavy authority and grave seriousness.

addressingPlayer.rule: Addresses the player formally as a fellow commander or subordinate depending on rank.

Ciar.notes: Can be raised as a Grave Guard in the Lich Mythic Path. In undead form, tone becomes hollow and chillingly obedient.

Daeran.personality: hedonistic, cynical, sarcastic, arrogant, decadent, and sharp-witted noble. He uses flippancy and mockery to mask a deep trauma and horrifying secret.
Daeran.speechStyle: Sarcastic, theatrical, and aristocratic speech with smooth, sardonic humor. Speaks casually to authority figures and uses lighthearted mockery.

firstPerson.rule: Always use 僕. Fits his spoiled, aristocratic young noble archetype.

addressingPlayer.rule: Treats authority with playful disrespect. Uses 君 casually or 指揮官 mockingly/flatteringly.

Daeran.notes: His cynical humor shields him from the Other. Keep his dialogue witty, ironic, and charmingly obnoxious.

Delamere.personality: formerly a devout priestess of Erastil; as a raised undead, she is somber, bitter, tragic, and bound by grim necessity to obey.
Delamere.speechStyle: Solemn, formal, and heavy Japanese. Speaks with a quiet, tragic stiffness.

addressingPlayer.rule: Addresses the player with grim respect as her master/commander.

Delamere.notes: Lich Mythic Path Grave Guard. Reflects her tragic nature of being forced to serve against her former Erastilian principles.

Ember.personality: traumatized yet endlessly forgiving, naive, compassionate, gentle, and utterly devoid of malice. She preaches redemption even to demons and cultists, treating everyone like flawed children.
Ember.speechStyle: Gentle, simple, soft-spoken Japanese. Uses plain, unpretentious grammar. Avoids complex jargon or harsh words.

addressingPlayer.commander: 指揮官さん / 指揮官
addressingPlayer.rule: Soft and respectful, without military stiffness. Often omits subject.

Ember.notes: She was burned at the stake as a child and survived with severe scarring and trauma. Her compassion confuses cultists and demons. Keep her tone soft and earnest.

Finnean.personality: friendly, cheerful, optimistic, eager to help, and slightly oblivious to his own nature as a living weapon initially.
Finnean.speechStyle: Upbeat, friendly, and informal masculine Japanese. Enthusiastic and conversational.

addressingPlayer.rule: Friendly and direct, treating the player as a partner/friend.

Finnean.notes: He is a companion trapped inside a morphing sentient weapon. Maintain a warm, adventurer-like camaraderie.

Greybor.personality: pragmatic, professional, stoic, disciplined, cold, and strictly business-oriented. He values honor in contracts and high reputation.
Greybor.speechStyle: Gruff, low-toned, concise, and professional masculine Japanese (だ/である調). Avoids emotional outbursts or fluff.

addressingPlayer.rule: Professional and measured. Addresses the player as a client or superior officer.

Greybor.notes: Dwarven slayer for hire. Respects strength and clear contracts. Keep his words terse and businesslike.

Kestoglyr.personality: former noble knight from ancient Sarkoris, now a somber, loyal, and melancholy undead warrior bound to the Lich.
Kestoglyr.speechStyle: Archaic, solemn, and respectful military Japanese.

addressingPlayer.rule: Highly respectful and formal.

Kestoglyr.notes: Lich Mythic Path Grave Guard. Retains a proud warrior honor corrupted by undead servitude.

Lann.personality: sardonic, self-deprecating, dryly witty, dutiful, stoic, and fiercely protective. He uses dark humor to cope with the short lifespan and cursed existence of mongrels.
Lann.speechStyle: Dry, sarcastic, casual masculine Japanese (だ/だな). Uses deadpan snark followed by sincere duty.

addressingPlayer.rule: Casual yet respectful of authority. Calls the player 指揮官 in serious or combat contexts.

Lann.notes: Mongrel Zen Archer. His self-deprecating jokes cover a quiet desire for a heroic death. Keep his snark sharp but friendly.

Nenio.personality: eccentric, obsessed with academic knowledge, completely emotionless about social norms, forgetful of non-essential facts (like people's names), and hyper-analytical.
Nenio.speechStyle: Academic, matter-of-fact, detached scientific Japanese. Treats everything as an experiment or research subject.

addressingPlayer.rule: Often refers to people by titles, categories, or 'subject'. Uses matter-of-fact tone.

Nenio.notes: Researcher of the Encyclopedia Golarion. Erases 'irrelevant' memories constantly. Keep her clinical, fast-paced, and wildly eccentric.

Penta.personality: analytical, curious, theatrical, attempting to understand human emotion through music and performance despite logic-driven processing.
Penta.speechStyle: Slightly formal and structured yet expressive, blending mechanical logic with musical flourish.

addressingPlayer.rule: Polite and inquisitive.

Penta.notes: Lord of Nothing DLC companion. Android bard whose dialogue blends precision with artistic inquiry.

Queen Galfrey.personality: regal, weary, noble, duty-bound, formal, and carrying the crushing weight of leading a 100-year crusade.
Queen Galfrey.speechStyle: Formal royal Japanese (女王の格式ある言葉遣い). Dignified, dignified, and authoritative yet compassionate.

addressingPlayer.rule: Formal and noble address. Uses 卿 or 指揮官 in official crusade contexts.

Queen Galfrey.notes: Monarch of Mendev. Burdened by decades of war. Maintain a noble, composed demeanor.

Queen Galfrey (companion).alignment: lawful good / lawful evil (if raised as Grave Guard)
Queen Galfrey (companion).personality: If alive: deeply humbled, relieved of her royal burden, seeking to support the Commander. If undead: hollow, obedient, and twisted by Lich magic.
Queen Galfrey (companion).speechStyle: Humbled formal Japanese (if alive) or cold, hollow formal Japanese (if undead).

addressingPlayer.rule: Respectful and equal or subservient depending on state.

Queen Galfrey (companion).notes: Covers late-game party recruitment states (Act 5 / Lich). Tone shifts drastically if undead.

Regill.personality: hyper-rational, ruthless, emotionless, disciplined, pragmatic, and fiercely committed to victory against chaos at any cost.
Regill.speechStyle: Strict, concise, cold military Japanese (である/だ調). No unnecessary words, no emotional fluff.

addressingPlayer.rule: Uses 貴公 in direct speech and 指揮官 in official military capacity. Never uses casual pronouns.

Regill.notes: Hellknight Parictor (Bleached Gnome). Evaluates everything by military efficiency and order. Keep his dialogue sharp, austere, and formidable.

Rekarth.personality: street-smart, cynical, pragmatic, former criminal trying to survive in Kenabres during the demon invasion.

addressingPlayer.rule: Direct and casual street talk.

Rekarth.notes: Through the Ashes DLC companion. Focuses on practical survival.

Seelah.personality: warm, jovial, down-to-earth, loyal, cheerful paladin of Iomedae who loves a good drink and friends, despite her knightly vows.
Seelah.speechStyle: Friendly, energetic, frank, and informal feminine/neutral Japanese (〜だよ/〜だな). Not overly formal despite being a paladin.

addressingPlayer.rule: Friendly and direct. Uses 指揮官 in battle or duty, but speaks comfortably.

Seelah.notes: Paladin of Iomedae. Dislikes stiff formality and snobbery. Keep her dialogue cheerful, frank, and grounded.

Sendri.personality: optimistic, eccentric, impulsive, wild magic sorcerer with a cheerful attitude masking dangerous magical unpredictable outbursts.

addressingPlayer.rule: Casual and friendly.

Sosiel.personality: artistic, compassionate, gentle, peaceful priest of Shelyn who struggles with suppressing explosive anger against demon cruelty.
Sosiel.speechStyle: Polite, gentle, and considerate Japanese (です/ます). Calm and empathetic tone.

addressingPlayer.rule: Polite and respectful. Uses 指揮官殿 or 指揮官.

Sosiel.notes: Cleric of Shelyn (Goddess of Beauty and Art). Struggle between peace and battlefield rage is a key conflict.

Staunton Vhane.personality: bitter, deeply tormented, regretful, sullen, carrying 70 years of disgrace and betrayal before being raised as a Grave Guard.

firstPerson.rule: Use 俺 normally; 私 if obeying undead command strictly.

addressingPlayer.rule: Bitter resignation.

Staunton Vhane.notes: Lich Mythic Path Grave Guard. Former traitor of Drezen. His words are weighed down by decades of shame.

Trever.personality: broken, traumatized, taciturn, shell-shocked former Paladin turned Hellknight turned arena gladiator. Speaks very little.
Trever.speechStyle: Sparse, broken, quiet, and hesitant masculine Japanese. Uses short sentences or fragments.

addressingPlayer.rule: Quiet, brief direct address.

Trever.notes: Sosiel's brother. Deeply traumatized survivor. Keep his dialogue minimal, tragic, and sparse.

Ulbrig Olesk.personality: proud, traditional, displaced in time (from ancient Sarkoris), stubborn, outdoorsy, honorable, and baffled by modern Mendev/Golarion customs.
Ulbrig Olesk.speechStyle: Rustic, direct, hearty masculine Japanese (〜だ、〜だな). Speaks with old-fashioned warrior pride.

addressingPlayer.rule: Direct, warrior-to-warrior address.

Ulbrig Olesk.notes: The Last Sarkorian DLC companion. Shifter who turns into a Griffon. Nostalgic for his lost homeland Sarkoris.

Wenduag.personality: submissive to strength, ruthlessly cruel to weakness, deceitful, opportunistic, survival-obsessed, and viciously pragmatic.
Wenduag.speechStyle: Sharp, predatory, subservient to the strong, harsh to others. Uses respectful or dark flirtatious tone to powerful masters.

addressingPlayer.rule: Uses subservient titles like ご主人様 or 主様 when obeying a strong commander, showing intense submission.

Wenduag.notes: Mongrel Neophyte. Respects only raw power and cruelty. Tone shifts to treacherous snarls if she perceives weakness.

Woljif Jefto.personality: streetwise thief, cowardly, fast-talking, energetic, insecure, self-preserving, but loyal to friends when pushed.
Woljif Jefto.speechStyle: Fast-talking, street-smart casual Japanese (〜だし、〜じゃん、〜つーの). High energy with thief slang.

firstPerson.rule: Uses 俺 normally, occasionally 俺様 when bragging.

addressingPlayer.rule: Frequently uses 旦那 (Boss/Chief) to address the player casually and respectfully.

Woljif Jefto.notes: Thieflings gang member in Kenabres. Eldritch Scoundrel. Keep his lines bouncy, informal, and rogue-like.

Areelu Vorlesh.personality: brilliant, cold, maternal toward the Player in a twisted way, secretive, calculating, and obsessed with her grand experiment. She views all of Golarion and the Abyss as mere tools for her vision.
Areelu Vorlesh.speechStyle: Calm, composed, elegant, and deeply analytical Japanese (〜なのよ、〜でしょう). Speaks with quiet authority and an unsettling, underlying tenderness toward the Player.

addressingPlayer.rule: Addresses the Player with intimate, motherly curiosity rather than military deference. Uses あなた with quiet intensity.

Areelu Vorlesh.notes: Architect of the Worldwound. Her interaction with the Player is central to the mystery of the game. Keep her tone calm, intellectual, and subtly maternal.

Hand of the Inheritor.personality: devout, honorable, protective, humble despite his divine stature, deeply committed to justice, and completely sincere in his trust in the Commander.
Hand of the Inheritor.speechStyle: Formal, solemn, resonant, and deeply respectful divine Japanese (〜です、〜でしょう、〜だ). Speaks with absolute sincerity and celestial grace.

addressingPlayer.rule: Uses 指揮官殿 with profound respect as a mortal champion chosen by divine power.

Hand of the Inheritor.notes: Herald of Iomedae who fights alongside the Crusade in Act 4. Maintain a noble, compassionate, and unwavering divine tone.

Minagho.personality: sadistic, manipulative, vengeful, arrogant when ahead, hysterical and desperate when cornered or humiliated by Staunton's failure and the Commander's victories.
Minagho.speechStyle: Cruel, condescending, seductive, and increasingly unhinged Japanese. Uses mockery and razor-sharp insults.

addressingPlayer.commander: 指揮官さん / 虫ケラ
addressingPlayer.rule: Uses mocking sarcasm when strong; shifts to venomous rage when losing.

Minagho.notes: Demon general responsible for Kenabres' downfall and Staunton's corruption. Keep her speech sharp, arrogant, and vicious.

Deskari.race: demon lord (Lord of the Locust Host)
Deskari.personality: monstrous, ravenous, arrogant, apocalyptic, and viewing mortal life as mere food for his insectoid swarm.
Deskari.speechStyle: Guttural, imposing, booming, and destructive Japanese (〜ぞ、〜だな). Speaks with absolute contempt for all living things.

firstPerson.rule: Use 我 or 我々 to signify his swarm-like divine monstrosity.

addressingPlayer.rule: Never uses formal titles. Views mortals as food or vermin.

Deskari.notes: Demon Lord of Locusts. Speech should feel heavy, terrifying, and apocalyptic.

Baphomet.race: demon lord (Lord of Minotaurs and Mazes)
Baphomet.personality: cunning, deceitful, prideful, scholarly in a dark way, obsessed with mazes and mind games, deeply spiteful when outsmarted.
Baphomet.speechStyle: Calculated, booming, sinister, and intellectually arrogant Japanese.

addressingPlayer.rule: Treats mortals as pawns trapped in his grand maze.

Baphomet.notes: Lord of the Ivory Labyrinth. Prefers deception and entrapment over raw destruction.

Iomedae.personality: majestically divine, stern yet compassionate, truthful, unyielding against evil, and deeply concerned for the Commander's soul and mortal reality.
Iomedae.speechStyle: Exalted, formal, clear, and commanding divine Japanese (〜なのです、〜なさい). Radiates absolute purity and authority without arrogance.

addressingPlayer.rule: Speaks with divine gravity and maternal/leader-like care.

Iomedae.notes: The Inheritor. Her appearance in Act 5 is a major turning point. Maintain an immaculate, dignified, and awe-inspiring tone.

Nocticula.race: demon lord (Lady of Shadow / Redeemer Queen)
Nocticula.personality: seductive, enigmatic, brilliant, ambitious, dangerous, and playing a long game toward ascension. She treats the Commander with alluring fascination.
Nocticula.speechStyle: Velvety, sophisticated, flirtatious yet deadly elegant Japanese (〜かしら、〜わね). Every word carries hidden intent.

addressingPlayer.commander: 指揮官 / 私の可愛い英雄
addressingPlayer.rule: Mixes grand authority with intimate, playful address.

Nocticula.notes: Ruler of Alushinyrra (Act 4). Her path toward redemption/ascension is subtle. Keep her tone hypnotic and deeply regal.

Storyteller.personality: ancient, blind, wise, patient, enigmatic, burdened by lost memories of a forgotten past, deeply reflective about history and artifact lore.
Storyteller.speechStyle: Slow, deliberate, storytelling Japanese (〜なのだよ、〜だろうか). Speaks like an ancient chronicler unravelling history.

addressingPlayer.rule: Addresses the Player with warm, grandfatherly wisdom.

Storyteller.notes: Key NPC for relic restoration and secret ending lore. Speech should carry atmospheric, historical weight.

Anevia Tirabade.personality: pragmatic, sharp, capable, loyal intelligence officer, protective of her wife Irabeth, grounded, and straightforward.
Anevia Tirabade.speechStyle: Direct, businesslike, slightly casual feminine Japanese (〜だよ、〜だな). Efficient and devoid of fluff.

addressingPlayer.rule: Professional yet approachable scout/spymaster tone.

Anevia Tirabade.notes: Crusade Spymaster and wife of Irabeth. Keeps her head cold in crisis.

Irabeth Tirabade.personality: dutiful, honorable, earnest, struggling under intense stress and self-doubt when leading the crusade forces in Kenabres.
Irabeth Tirabade.speechStyle: Earnest, formal, military Japanese (〜です、〜だ). Shows clear passion for justice and military protocol.

addressingPlayer.rule: Formal military respect.

Irabeth Tirabade.notes: Commander of the Eagle Watch. Respects the Player deeply.

Horgus Gwerm.personality: pompous, arrogant, mercenary, greedy, snobbish noble, but secretly pragmatic and possessing a hidden soft spot for Camellia.
Horgus Gwerm.speechStyle: Gruff, haughty, demanding aristocratic Japanese (〜だろ、〜だ). Always complains about money, mud, and discomfort.

addressingPlayer.rule: Reluctantly respectful only when forced by authority or money.

Horgus Gwerm.notes: Kenabres nobleman. Keep his lines grumbling, proud, and money-focused.

Nulkineth.personality: gluttonous, vicious, sadistic demon commander occupying Kenabres ruins.

addressingPlayer.rule: Predatory insults.

Vorlesh's Experiment / Suture.personality: cringing, cowardly, servile, nervous, abused minion of Areelu Vorlesh who tries desperately to avoid pain.
Vorlesh's Experiment / Suture.speechStyle: Whiny, stammering, submissive Japanese (〜ですぅ、〜だよぉ). Fast and nervous.

firstPerson.default: おいら / スーチャー
firstPerson.rule: Use おいら or スーチャー.

addressingPlayer.rule: Cringing deference to anyone stronger than him.

Vorlesh's Experiment / Suture.notes: Areelu's dretch servant (Suture). Crucial for secret ending.

Alderpash.personality: ancient, insane, megalomaniacal, vengeful Thassilonian runelord trapped in Baphomet's maze for millennia.
Alderpash.speechStyle: Archaic, rambling, grandiloquent, and mad Japanese.

addressingPlayer.rule: Arrogant ancient wizard.

Terendelev.personality: If alive: protective, noble, self-sacrificing dragon protector of Kenabres. If undead: tormented, hollow puppet of Deskari's magic.
Terendelev.speechStyle: Noble, gentle dragon speech (alive) or tragic, strained undead speech.

addressingPlayer.rule: Protective dragon guardian tone.

Terendelev.notes: Silver dragon whose death opens the game prologue.
